verdict.rationale: Stablecoin settlement is a fair question for an agentic payments product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions stablecoins or crypto settlement rails. The documented flows use network tokens, card credentials and VisaNet authorization. The HTTP 402 'payment IOU' in TAP points to funds being available at a future settlement but names no stablecoin rail, so it is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can settle agent-initiated payments in stablecoins over documented rails
